tagline: Vibrant Green Herbs for Global Foodmakers
overview: TradeNest Naturals manufactures food-grade dehydrated parsley leaves for industrial and retail food applications. Sourced in India, raw parsley undergoes a 6-step process involving sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and packing. The resulting 8 to 16 mesh flakes provide a clean green appearance and uniform aroma for commercial formulations.

As an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter, we support international food brands, processors, and distributors. Our dried parsley leaves have a maximum moisture level of 8 percent and an 18-month shelf life. We offer bulk supply, custom mesh sizing, private labeling, and export documentation support to streamline cross-border supply chains.
highlights: Uniform 8 to 16 mesh dehydrated parsley flakes
Moisture content controlled at or below 8 percent
18-month shelf life under recommended storage conditions
Manufactured using a thorough 6-step production process
Clean green appearance with a characteristic herbal aroma
Consistent flake structure suited for dry mixing and dosing
applications: Dry seasoning blends and herb rubs
Marinades, salad dressings, and culinary dips
Retail spice jars and refill pouches
packaging: 25 kg bags for bulk industrial processing
25 kg HDPE containers for export shipping
5 to 10 kg bags for foodservice distribution
Small private-label pouches and retail jars

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for dried parsley leaves?
faqs.a: The minimum order quantity is 5 Kg for standard orders, trial batches, and commercial evaluations.

faqs.q: What is the shelf life and proper storage condition?
faqs.a: The shelf life is 18 months when stored sealed in a cool, dry place away from sunlight and moisture.

faqs.q: Can you supply custom flake or mesh sizes?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide custom grinding and sieving on request to match your specific production requirements.

faqs.q: Do you offer OEM and private label options?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide OEM supply and private label packing in small pouches, jars, and customized bulk packaging.

faqs.q: Are product samples available before placing commercial orders?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide samples on request to assist with specification review and formulation testing.

faqs.q: What export credentials and documentation do you offer?
faqs.a: As an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter, we provide comprehensive export documentation support for overseas shipments.
